title: The Story of the Qipao
synopsis: Learn the history of how the qipao came to be.

fullText.simplified:
旗袍的故事

    旗袍是中国女子的一种传统服装，它有着古典的东方韵味，还有着沧桑变幻的往昔。它表现出了中华女性典雅清丽的性情和气质。在如今世界时装周的秀场上，越来越多的设计师们以旗袍为灵感，设计出了别样的作品。
    旗袍的历史可以追溯到居住在关外的满族人身上。因满族人又称“旗人”，所以他们穿的衣服被称为“旗袍”。当时满族的旗袍是圆领的，非常宽大，男女都可以穿。关外寒冷的天气，游牧民族骑马射猎的生活方式，催生出了这种保暖实用的服装。
    随着满族的统治者进入北京，旗袍也成为了宫廷服饰，装饰更为精细。宫廷女子穿旗袍时，往往配上假发和“花盆底”的旗鞋，显得女子身材修长，风姿优雅。不过那个时候的旗袍与现代的旗袍在样式、剪裁、装饰上都相差甚远。
    清朝之后，旗袍成为了汉族女子的流行服饰。早在1913年就已经出现了身穿旗袍的一批上海女学生，她们穿着宽敞的蓝布旗袍走在街上，引起了各界女子的羡慕。当时的女学生代表着自由与解放的女性形象，她们的着装往往会成为社会时尚的风向标，因此她们穿的旗袍也成为了文明、新潮的象征，引得人们纷纷效仿。上海也因此成为了现代旗袍的发祥地。
    此时的旗袍在风格上与满族旗袍有了很大的差别：装饰由复杂转向简单，款式由宽大转到适度，衣服的长度缩短到了膝盖与脚踝之间……
    随着时代的发展，女性在解放潮流中张扬个性，旗袍的样式变化得更为大胆了。旗袍的下摆线提高到了膝下，收腰造型开始出现。女学生的旗袍开始露出了青春健美的小腿，穿着这种款式的旗袍，打球、骑车都毫无阻碍。
    1929年，旗袍被写进了典章，规定在重要的场合女性必须穿着旗袍。在之后的十年中，旗袍绚丽多姿，风格多变。领、袖、下摆、开衩，随着流行时尚不断变化。高领、低领、无领先后流行，长袖、短袖、无袖各显其美。欧美流行元素轮番登场，高跟鞋等配饰令人眼花缭乱，呈现了旗袍发展史上最绚丽华美的时代。
    如今的旗袍被改良得越发具有时尚感，在国际时装舞台上频频亮相，还被视为一种有民族代表意义的正式礼服出现在各种国际社交礼仪场合。旗袍向人们展示着东方女子的温柔典雅，相信在未来会有更多的人领略到旗袍的情怀，也会有更多的人爱上这种传统服饰。
fullText.traditional:
旗袍的故事

    旗袍是中國女子的一種傳統服裝，它有著古典的東方韻味，還有著滄桑變幻的往昔。它表現出了中華女性典雅清麗的性情和氣質。在如今世界時裝周的秀場上，越來越多的設計師們以旗袍為靈感，設計出了別樣的作品。
    旗袍的歷史可以追溯到居住在關外的滿族人身上。因滿族人又稱“旗人”，所以他們穿的衣服被稱為“旗袍”。當時滿族的旗袍是圓領的，非常寬大，男女都可以穿。關外寒冷的天氣，遊牧民族騎馬射獵的生活方式，催生出了這種保暖實用的服裝。
    隨著滿族的統治者進入北京，旗袍也成為了宮廷服飾，裝飾更為精細。宮廷女子穿旗袍時，往往配上假髮和“花盆底”的旗鞋，顯得女子身材修長，風姿優雅。不過那個時候的旗袍與現代的旗袍在樣式、剪裁、裝飾上都相差甚遠。
    清朝之後，旗袍成為了漢族女子的流行服飾。早在1913年就已經出現了身穿旗袍的一批上海女學生，她們穿著寬敞的藍布旗袍走在街上，引起了各界女子的羨慕。當時的女學生代表著自由與解放的女性形象，她們的著裝往往會成為社會時尚的風向標，因此她們穿的旗袍也成為了文明、新潮的象徵，引得人們紛紛傚仿。上海也因此成為了現代旗袍的發祥地。
    此時的旗袍在風格上與滿族旗袍有了很大的差別：裝飾由複雜轉向簡單，款式由寬大轉到適度，衣服的長度縮短到了膝蓋與腳踝之間……
    隨著時代的發展，女性在解放潮流中張揚個性，旗袍的樣式變化得更為大膽了。旗袍的下擺線提高到了膝下，收腰造型開始出現。女學生的旗袍開始露出了青春健美的小腿，穿著這種款式的旗袍，打球、騎車都毫無阻礙。
    1929年，旗袍被寫進了典章，規定在重要的場合女性必須穿著旗袍。在之後的十年中，旗袍絢麗多姿，風格多變。領、袖、下擺、開衩，隨著流行時尚不斷變化。高領、低領、無領先後流行，長袖、短袖、無袖各顯其美。歐美流行元素輪番登場，高跟鞋等配飾令人眼花繚亂，呈現了旗袍發展史上最絢麗華美的時代。
    如今的旗袍被改良得越發具有時尚感，在國際時裝舞臺上頻頻亮相，還被視為一種有民族代表意義的正式禮服出現在各種國際社交禮儀場合。旗袍向人們展示著東方女子的溫柔典雅，相信在未來會有更多的人領略到旗袍的情懷，也會有更多的人愛上這種傳統服飾。

sentences.traditional: 長袖、短袖、無袖各顯其美。
sentences.pinyin: cháng xiù duǎn xiù wú xiù gè xiǎn qí měi
sentences.english: High collar, low collar, and collarless were all popular at different times.

sentences.simplified: 欧美流行元素轮番登场，高跟鞋等配饰令人眼花缭乱，
sentences.traditional: 歐美流行元素輪番登場，高跟鞋等配飾令人眼花繚亂，
sentences.pinyin: ōu měi liú xíng yuán sù lún fān dēng chǎng gāo gēn xié děng pèi shì lìng rén yǎn huā liáo luàn
sentences.english: Long-sleeve, short-sleeve, and sleeveless each had their own beauty.

sentences.simplified: 呈现了旗袍发展史上最绚丽华美的时代。
sentences.traditional: 呈現了旗袍發展史上最絢麗華美的時代。
sentences.pinyin: chéng xiàn le qí páo fā zhǎn shǐ shang zuì xuàn lì huá měi de shí dài
sentences.english: As elements from Western fashion appeared one after the other, high heels and other accessories dazzled the eye.
They represent the most gorgeous and magnificent era in the history of the qipao.

sentences.simplified: 如今的旗袍被改良得越发具有时尚感，
sentences.traditional: 如今的旗袍被改良得越發具有時尚感，
sentences.pinyin: rú jīn de qí páo bèi gǎi liáng de yuè fā jù yǒu shí shàng gǎn

sentences.simplified: 在国际时装舞台上频频亮相，
sentences.traditional: 在國際時裝舞臺上頻頻亮相，
sentences.pinyin: zài guó jì shí zhuāng wǔ tái shang pín pín liàng xiàng
sentences.english: Today’s qipao has been modified to become more and more fashionable, ..

sentences.simplified: 还被视为一种有民族代表意义的正式礼服出现在各种国际社交礼仪场合。
sentences.traditional: 還被視為一種有民族代表意義的正式禮服出現在各種國際社交禮儀場合。
sentences.pinyin: hái bèi shì wéi yì zhǒng yǒu mín zú dài biǎo yì yì de zhèng shì lǐ fú chū xiàn zài gè zhǒng guó jì shè jiāo lǐ yí chǎng hé
sentences.english: .. and appears frequently on international fashion stages.

sentences.simplified: 旗袍向人们展示着东方女子的温柔典雅，
sentences.traditional: 旗袍向人們展示著東方女子的溫柔典雅，
sentences.pinyin: qí páo xiàng rén men zhǎn shì zhe dōng fāng nǚ zǐ de wēn róu diǎn yǎ
sentences.english: It is also seen as formal wear that signifies the nation, and has appeared in all sorts of international social events.

sentences.simplified: 相信在未来会有更多的人领略到旗袍的情怀，
sentences.traditional: 相信在未來會有更多的人領略到旗袍的情懷，
sentences.pinyin: xiāng xìn zài wèi lái huì yǒu gèng duō de rén lǐng lüè dào qí páo de qíng huái
sentences.english: The qipao presents to others the gentleness and elegance of East Asian women.

sentences.simplified: 也会有更多的人爱上这种传统服饰。
sentences.traditional: 也會有更多的人愛上這種傳統服飾。
sentences.pinyin: yě huì yǒu gèng duō de rén ài shàng zhè zhǒng chuán tǒng fú shì
sentences.english: I trust that in the future more people will come to appreciate the sentiment behind the qipao, ..
.. and that more people will come to love this traditional item of clothing.

raw.synopsis: Learn the history of how the qipao came to be.
sentence_translations: The Story of the Qipao
The qipao is a traditional clothing item for Chinese women.
It has a classic Eastern charm, as well as a storied past filled with changes.
It brings out the qualities of elegance in character and temperament of Chinese women.
Nowadays, at fashion weeks across the world, ..
.. more and more designers are using the qipao as inspiration to design unconventional pieces.
The history of the qipao can be traced back to the Manchu people, who lived north of the Great Wall.
Because the Manchu people were also called the “Qi people”, the clothes they wore were called “qipao”.
At the time, the Machu people’s qipao had round collars, were very loose, and could be worn by both men and women.
The cold weather north of the Great Wall, along with the nomadic lifestyle of hunting on horseback, ..
.. gave rise to this warm and practical piece of clothing.
When Manchu rule arrived in Beijing,
the qipao also became the clothing of the imperial court, and its accessories became more refined.
When the court ladies wore qipao, they often paired it with a wig and the “flower pot shoes” of the Qi people.
This created a slender figure and a graceful demeanor.
But the qipao of those times and the modern qipao differ greatly in style, cut, and accessories.
After the Qing dynasty, the qipao became popular apparel amongst Han Chinese women.
As early as 1913 there were a group of female students in Shanghai that wore qipao.
They wore wide and flowy qipao made of blue fabric in town, inciting the envy of women from all walks of life.
The female students of that time represented an image of freedom and liberation for women.
Their way of dressing often became a marker for fashion in society.
Therefore, the qipao that they wore also became a symbol of culture and fashion, ..
..  leading people to imitate it one after another.
Shanghai hence became the birthplace of the modern qipao.
The qipao of this time also differed greatly from the Manchu qipao in style.
The accessories changed from complex to simple; the design changed from loose to well-fitted.
The length was shortened to fall between the knee and the ankle…
As time progressed, women began to flaunt their personalities during the tides of liberation.
The changes in the style of the qipao were even more daring.
The hem of the qipao was raised to just under the knee, and styles that cinched the waist began to appear.
Qipao worn by female students began to expose youthful and beautiful legs.
While wearing this style of qipao, playing sports or riding a bike could be done without any hindrance.
In 1929, the qipao was written into a decree. It was stipulated that women must wear the qipao at important occasions.
In the following ten years, the qipao was very vibrant and colorful, and came in many different styles.
The collar, the sleeves, the hem, and the slits were all constantly changing with the fashion trends.
High collar, low collar, and collarless were all popular at different times.
Long-sleeve, short-sleeve, and sleeveless each had their own beauty.
As elements from Western fashion appeared one after the other, high heels and other accessories dazzled the eye.
They represent the most gorgeous and magnificent era in the history of the qipao.
Today’s qipao has been modified to become more and more fashionable, ..
.. and appears frequently on international fashion stages.
It is also seen as formal wear that signifies the nation, and has appeared in all sorts of international social events.
The qipao presents to others the gentleness and elegance of East Asian women.
I trust that in the future more people will come to appreciate the sentiment behind the qipao, ..
.. and that more people will come to love this traditional item of clothing.
